description: One developer or shareholder named in the Saudi Renewables Tracker, by the slug on its page (acwa-power, masdar, edf-renewables, saudi-aramco-power …; search_projects returns developers as published). Returns every project that names it with the equity share the developers publish, its capacity by stage (operational, construction, tendered) and by technology in MW, the capacity attributable by published equity share over the projects that publish one, and recent change-ledger entries across its projects. Spellings of one company (EDF and EDF Renewables; SAPCO, Aramco Power and Saudi Aramco Power) are read as one. Stage totals count each project’s whole capacity; never add them across companies. `coverage` lists the company’s Saudi captive and corporate projects, its GCC projects and its projects in the Regional and World Renewables Trackers, with capacity as each source states it; those are not in the stage totals. A company named only there (ENGIE, TAQA, DEWA …) is answered too, and so is a company in the Saudi power-project value chain that no tracker names (contractors, equipment makers, O&M companies, consultants: arabian-transformers, carlo-gavazzi-arabia …), whose `facts` give what its own website states, the pages read and the day.

company.description: Company slug, e.g. acwa-power; a published name is accepted too
